tasks.name: Daily Compliance Check
tasks.description: Run Raindeer-AWI compliance-check baseline to catch ledger/gate/registry drift
tasks.prompt: Run .\harness\compliance-check.ps1 -Mode baseline -Format text. If findings > 0, append a §5 ledger entry with remediation plan.

tasks.name: Daily Health Check
tasks.description: Run omo-health-monitor heartbeat, check for degraded agents, log status
tasks.prompt: Run health check: scan harness/progress.md for stalled tasks, check harness/feature_list.json for stuck features, report any anomalies.

tasks.name: Loop Engineering Tick
tasks.description: Autonomous loop continuation without user prompt; read loop-tick-prompt and execute next atomic action
tasks.prompt: From repo root: python harness/loop_tick.py emit-prompt — then execute ONE loop tick per that prompt. Update loop-state.json and five sync sources. Run: python harness/methodology_memory_lifecycle.py run --apply

tasks.name: Methodology Memory Lifecycle
tasks.description: Dream digest, dedupe M-xx entries, expire old rounds
tasks.prompt: Run: python harness/methodology_memory_lifecycle.py run --apply from repo root. If dream candidates exist, note in METHODOLOGY_MEMORY.

tasks.name: Weekly Capability Curation
tasks.description: Run capability-accumulation curator cycle: review, grade, merge, prune skills
tasks.prompt: Run the curator cycle: review all capability cards, grade their current value, merge overlapping ones, prune low-value ones.

tasks.name: Post-Session Retrospective
tasks.description: After each development session, extract patterns into METHODOLOGY_MEMORY
tasks.prompt: Review METHODOLOGY_MEMORY latest round and PROJECT_STATUS §5; extract patterns; run methodology_memory_lifecycle.py --apply.

tasks.name: Weekly Progress Summary
tasks.description: Summarize the week's progress: features completed, blockers, next priorities
tasks.prompt: Read harness/progress.md and harness/feature_list.json. Summarize: what was completed this week, what is blocked, what should be the top 3 priorities next week. Write to harness/progress.md.

tasks.name: Daily Compliance (End of Day)
tasks.description: EOD full compliance: compliance-check, five lifecycles, sync/verification summary, dual git status, gap blockers → harness/reports/daily-compliance-YYYYMMDD.md
tasks.prompt: Read harness/templates/daily-compliance-prompt.md and execute fully. Machine wrapper: .\harness\scripts\daily-compliance.ps1 from repo root. Do NOT change loop-state next_atomic_action.

tasks.name: Daily Git Push (End of Day)
tasks.description: After daily-compliance: push raindeer root + quant_assistant if ahead of origin; fail-closed on .env staged; no force; user confirmed 2026-06-20
tasks.prompt: Read harness/templates/daily-git-push-prompt.md and run .\harness\scripts\daily-git-push.ps1 from repo root. Push only when commits exist (ahead > 0).
